oracles.rationale: The `gif` crate's reader accepts GIF87a's own magic (`Version::V87a`) natively, so it doubles as an independent GIF87a parser and mutator for this subset's own mutation vocabulary — screen/GCT/image-sequence, no GCE-shaped kinds, since 87a genuinely has none. Distinct from the shared `gif` entry in the plugin-root manifest: that one declares `gif-raster` (round-trip creation), this one declares `gif-87a-mutate` (the capability this wave's feature tags), per subset.
